title: Exclusive: US military had close call after using AI for false intelligence report, sources say

reports.title: Exclusive: US military had close call after using AI for false intelligence report, sources say

summary:
According to sources, the US military had a close call after using artificial intelligence to produce a false intelligence report. The incident involved military personnel coming near to acting on incorrect information generated by an AI system, though the available text does not name specific individuals, branches, or locations. The headline describes the report as exclusive, but the body of the article is not included in the provided text.

No key numbers, such as dates, casualty figures, or the scale of the incident, are given in the available material. The article also does not state what happens next, including whether there will be an investigation, policy changes, or disciplinary action. Because only the headline information is present, a fuller summary of who was involved and the consequences cannot be provided.
